title: Small RNA sequencing of human salivary extracellular vesicles
description: Isolated extracellular vesicles (EV)-derived RNA was processed for small RNA library preparation. Libraries were sequenced in SE150 mode on a NovaSeq6000 platform (Illumina, San Diego, USA). The study aimed at deciphering the salivary EV-microRNA profile in relation to taste perception as an engine of food consumption and metabolic pathways of obesity.
